The text is structured as a high-level outline or table of contents for a larger document regarding the history and future of robotics. It utilizes Roman numerals (I through IV) to denote major sections, each accompanied by a descriptive heading. The organization follows a logical chronological and thematic progression: starting with an introduction, moving to historical origins, transitioning to contemporary developments, and concluding with future outlooks. Transitions are implied through the sequential numbering and the descriptive nature of the headings, which guide the reader from the past to the present and finally to the future.

The first three months of the year are January, February, and March.
